testcase.name: No curve work: evaluate never calls a Curve (shapes are copied when built); 1,000 frames of a scene built from a counting curve add 0 calls
Largest frame: one layer of 2^20 points on a moving, rotated, scaled anchor evaluates with every coordinate finite and in shape order
Preflight: the scene is rejected at construction when the sum of shape sizes exceeds maxPointsPerFrame (sum in long, no overflow); accepted at exactly the limit; 4096 layers of 256 points fill 2^20
Motion depth: at most 16 steps per motion (Motion.MAX_STEPS), so a layer costs at most 16 drive samples and 17 pose compositions
